description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' JSON serialization support using System.Text.Json. It tests serialization, deep copy, and polymorphic serialization of various JSON types and classes, focusing on the JsonCodec and related serializers within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: JsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for JSON serialization and deep copy in Orleans, including handling of JsonNode types, JsonDocument, and JsonElement, verifying integration with Orleans' serializers.

classes.name: JsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for deep copying Orleans' JSON-related types and JsonNode subclasses, ensuring independent copies and proper serialization.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to support types marked with MyJsonSerializableAttribute.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a sample MyJsonClass instance with preset properties for testing.

methods.name: JsonSerializerDeepCopy
methods.description: Tests deep copying of MyJsonClass using Orleans' DeepCopier.

methods.name: JsonSerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies that a MyJsonClass instance can be serialized and deserialized correctly through Orleans' serializer.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonValue_AsJsonNode
methods.description: Tests serialization of JsonValue as JsonNode and verifies round-trip integrity.

methods.name: CanSerializeAllJsonNodeTypes
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of all subclasses of JsonNode, including JsonObject, JsonArray, and JsonValue.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonDocumentAndElement
methods.description: Verifies serialization and deserialization of JsonDocument and JsonElement types with Orleans.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Creates an Orleans deep copier for MyJsonClass.

methods.name: CanCopyNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Tests copying of JsonValue, JsonArray, and JsonObject using Orleans' DeepCopier.

methods.name: CanCopyJsonDocumentAndElement
methods.description: Tests copying of JsonDocument and JsonElement, ensuring the copies are independent.
